issue.title: Few useful doxygen tags in the source leads to Doc build error
issue.body:
Adding doxygen tags `@sa, @note, @para` leads to below error during `./generate_doc.sh`
```
  Generating: /home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/install/docs/xml/classdronecore_1_1_follow_me.xml (class xml)
Unhanded kind in simplesect tag in markdown_any_tag:kind: see
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py", line 968, in <module>
    markdown_string=currentClass.markdown()
  File "/home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py", line 871, in markdown
    outputstring+=the_function.markdown()
  File "/home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py", line 586, in markdown
    functionstring+='\n\n%s' % markdown_any_tag(self.detaileddescription).strip()
  File "/home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py", line 112, in markdown_any_tag
    child_text += markdown_any_tag(child,html=html,para=para) #.strip()
  File "/home/intel/karma/fork/follow-me/fresh/DroneCore/generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py", line 100, in markdown_any_tag
    child_text+=str(ET.tostring(child),'utf-8')
```
@hamishwillee Does it need fix in  `generate_markdown_from_doxygen_xml.py` ?

Thanks @shakthi-prashanth-m , but I wrote some test examples. You can try out the new version in #182 if you like.
This should be fixed now in develop. Give it a whirl :-)

issue.title: Add docs support for sa and note tags

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This adds support see also tags (sa) and note tags. The sa tag groups all marked lines as bullet points under a heading **See Also** as requested by #180 

The notes render as a gitbook note (ie `> **Note** Some text`). The problem is that you can only have single line notes - multi-line notes render as separate notes. 

It may be better to render these JUST like see also (under their own heading). Thoughts?

timeline.body: Thanks @shakthi-prashanth-m , but I wrote some test examples. You can try out the new version in #182 if you like.
This should be fixed now in develop. Give it a whirl :-)
